Game Overview

In Tenno 2, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the exciting world of Tenno 2, where an office worker's stealth is tested against cunning rivals. Navigate complex levels filled with menacing robots and treacherous spikes as you use precision jumps and strategic maneuvers to reclaim stolen documents and outsmart competitors. Are you ready for the challenge?
